verdict.rationale: The only evidence for scheduling is indirect: through its MCP integration, Superhuman Mail says it can draft follow-up nudges and "send at the time each recipient is most likely to open it", which is a timed deferred send. There is no evidence of user-chosen send-later times in the client, and nothing at all on undo-send. missing for 10: user-selectable schedule-send in the mail client, undo-send with a grace window, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule an email to send later and undo a send within a grace window

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send at the time each recipient is most likely to open it.
Handle every follow-up with one prompt. Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.
